name: newrez-bdd-playwright
description: Enterprise BDD Automation Framework — Playwright + Cucumber + Allure

_comments.about: This file defines the project and all the commands you can run from the terminal.
_comments.how_to_run: Open terminal in this folder and type: npm run <script-name>

scripts_explained.test: Runs ALL tests sequentially (one at a time)
scripts_explained.test:parallel: Runs ALL tests in parallel (3 workers simultaneously)
scripts_explained.test:parallel:loansearch: Runs loan search tests in parallel
scripts_explained.test:login: Runs ONLY the login scenarios (@login tag)
scripts_explained.test:dashboard: Runs ONLY the dashboard/loan search scenarios (@dashboard tag)
scripts_explained.test:smoke: Runs ONLY the smoke tests — quick sanity check (@smoke tag)
scripts_explained.test:negative: Runs ONLY the negative tests — invalid/empty credentials (@negative tag)
scripts_explained.test:loanid: Runs ONLY the Loan ID search scenario (@loanid tag)
scripts_explained.test:name: Runs ONLY the Name search scenario (@name tag)
scripts_explained.test:loansearch: Runs ALL loan search scenarios end-to-end (@dashboard tag)
scripts_explained.report:generate: Builds the HTML Allure report from allure-results/ folder
scripts_explained.report:open: Opens the generated Allure report in your browser
scripts_explained.test:report: Clears old results + runs all tests + generates the Allure report (all in one)
scripts_explained.test:report:parallel: Same as test:report but runs tests in parallel

dependencies_explained.@cucumber/cucumber: The BDD test runner — reads .feature files and runs step definitions
dependencies_explained.playwright: The browser automation engine — controls Chrome/Firefox/Safari
dependencies_explained.allure-cucumberjs: Connects Cucumber test results to the Allure report format
dependencies_explained.allure-commandline: The CLI tool used to generate and open the Allure HTML report
dependencies_explained.cucumber-html-reporter: Alternative HTML reporter (available but not currently used)

scripts.test:name: cucumber-js --profile default --tags @name
scripts.test:report: if exist allure-results rmdir /s /q allure-results & mkdir allure-results & cucumber-js --profile default & npm run report:generate
scripts.test:report:parallel: if exist allure-results rmdir /s /q allure-results & mkdir allure-results & cucumber-js --profile parallel & npm run report:generate
